description: Cameo Q-Spot 40 RGBW (40 W RGBW pinspot). The same five modes as the Q-Spot 15, named as the display and the manual print them (Q-Spot 40 manual p. 6, Q-Spot 15 manual p. 15); 03CH1 and 03CH2 are different layouts. Modes: 02CH, 03CH1, 03CH2, 04CH, 09CH; 04CH is the default. Generated from the Open Fixture Library (MIT licence, cameo/q-spot-40-rgbw at commit d9d675e) and checked against the manual.

modes.name: 02CH
modes.description: Dimmer (follows the brightness), Color Macros (held at 114). No colour mixing in this mode: only the brightness follows PitchControl.

modes.name: 03CH1
modes.description: Dimmer (follows the brightness), Strobe, Color Macros (held at 114). No colour mixing in this mode: only the brightness follows PitchControl.

modes.name: 09CH
modes.description: Dimmer (held at full), Dimmer fine (off), Strobe functions, RGBW, Color Macros (off), Color Temperature (off).
